system.description:
A nearby object no larger than a chair begins to enlarge. It grows up to ten times its size over one minute and remains this size for up to 30 minutes (3 dungeon actions). If it is a hard object, its growth will abate if it meets serious resistance, such as pressing into the walls and ceiling. A fragile object will shatter if its growth is met with this type of resistance.

For each spark, you can double how large it grows, but each doubling also reduces the magic's duration by half.
